name: assured-assessment-design-chatgpt-plugin
description: An adaptation of the Claude skill for educators designing assured assessment. Consults on your situation, checks current guidance and develops inclusive supervised or interactive options, with assurance ratings, staffing maths and a practical plan.

interface.longDescription: An adaptation of the Claude skill for educators designing assured assessment. Consults on your situation, checks current guidance and develops inclusive supervised or interactive options, with assurance ratings, staffing maths and a practical plan. Preserves Steps 0–6, moves M1–M10, scenarios A–L, Quick mode and the original 20-card library. Step 0 uses the session's web search tools; if unavailable, it discloses the baseline date, 24 November 2026.
defaultPrompt: Help me redesign a take-home assessment while keeping an in-person endpoint.
My students use an IT lab without locked-down computers. How can I assure their learning?
I have a large cohort and limited staff time. Help me find workable assessment options.
